text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —My throat is parched.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Lips deprived of water are dry and 
peeling. Yet even in that state, the body 
keeps breathing, longing to be 'filled.'

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Because "that" is an act meant for 
survival. ...Even if it's the very cause 
that brings about thirst.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Thus, praying that I will one day be 
fulfilled, I continue to draw air into my 
lungs.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Come to Tracen Academy. ...Perhaps it can 
satisfy your thirst.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Simply to run [to live].

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It's finally here, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At last, our Twinkle Series journey with 
Narita Brian begins.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What a foolish question.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I will warm up first. I'll see you on the 
track shortly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A course... By that, you must mean the 
training track."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quickly got ready and decided to go 
after her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrying my luggage out into the hallway, 
she was already nowhere to be seen.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Is that... the Trainer who teamed up with 
Brian?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's finally making her 
debut. Her older sister, Biwa Hayahide, 
has been making quite a splash in the 
Classics, though...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Her raw talent is said to surpass even her 
sister's. A Triple Crown Umamusume... No, 
she might even surpass Rudolf...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Full of curiosity, the center of 
everyone's attention.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Symboli Rudolf... Needless to say, she is 
Tracen Academy's student council 
president. A prestigious Triple Crown 
Umamusume whom everyone looks up to.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian. Her running possesses the 
power to carve out an unprecedented 
future. That is precisely why I appointed 
her as vice president.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it seems she already has 
enthusiastic fans. I've heard some are 
even comparing my records to what she has 
yet to achieve.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"That's just how much everyone is 
expecting from her. Including myself."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm very much looking forward to seeing 
what kind of horse girl you'll guide Brian 
into becoming.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And also what it is that Brian will grasp.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You're late.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Haah, haaah...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's engine... en... gine... 
*pssshhhh*...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
She was warming up her body. Through the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If it doesn't make my blood boil, it's 
meaningless. That's the only reason I 
sought an opponent.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's not enough... I'm not 
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Are there any volunteers?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: (Jolt!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Not here, huh.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're planning to race *again*? Twin 
Turbo made three in a row, didn't she...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I-Impossible. Running alongside someone 
like that. I'm... scared...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: Shall we move on to training soon?
Let's move on to training soon.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... How boring. A race is only 
meaningful when you've got real 
competition.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.
choice_data_list:
Once you debut, you'll have rivals out the 
wazoo.

Once you debut, you'll find plenty of 
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Because that's what the 'Twinkle Series' 
is"... is that it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Exactlyyyyy!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Like hell any of us are gonna go out 
as losers!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Hishi Amazon. The Miho Dorm leader, known 
as the "Empress" for her immense strength 
and renowned for her generous heart.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Brian, step outside! One lap around the 
turf course—it's a 1-on-1 showdown!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna beat the meaning of defeat right 
into you!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Oho.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Fascinating...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It's what comes after this!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh... haha!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I shall relish it to my heart's 
content...! This thing known as the 
Twinkle Series――!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our days walking alongside Narita 
Brian—a horse girl who wanted nothing more 
than to run forever—had begun.
